items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: I was doing work with Dave.

ctx.x: We were on reel number four with Wardell Cazare, same date as October 25, 1995.
And where were left though? With Dave.
I mean, we said, you know, that, yeah, he did that House Party record. And my point was, is there a point where Dave really trusts you? I think so. He says, oh, I can just give it to Wardell.
